description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_URI, which is responsible for validating URI values embedded within CSS syntax, particularly within url() functions. It extends functionality from parent class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI to specifically handle CSS URI syntax and escaping requirements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_URI
classes.description: Class for validating and sanitizing CSS URI values within style sheets, ensuring proper extraction, escaping, and validation of url() content in CSS syntax.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and sets the URI validation to always treat URIs as embedded.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Parses the CSS url() syntax, extracts the URI, escapes special characters, delegates validation to the parent class, and then re-escapes the characters for CSS compliance, returning the properly formatted url() string or false if invalid.
